Answering the citation-mirroring flag that falls on this row: the samekh after Ezek.36.38 the row argues from is verified in the mark inventory and is genuine behind-side onset corroboration, but it is argued in prose with no matching entry in the row's own evidence list, unlike the behind-side marks the sibling rows of this part do mirror.

items.claim: The whole-chapter span Ezek.38.1-Ezek.38.23 holds one literary movement under this book's conventions, and the row's refusal to cut at the messenger reopenings is the right reading of them. A word-event onset from the census's strict list stands at Ezek.38.1, corroborated by the set-your-face direction opener at Ezek.38.2 (one of nine) and the 'behold, I am against you' verdict at Ezek.38.3; the three reopenings at Ezek.38.10, Ezek.38.14 and Ezek.38.17 leave Gog as addressee throughout and none of them follows a refrain, so none meets either condition under which a messenger formula is read as a seam. The two utterance signatures at Ezek.38.18 and Ezek.38.21 are followed by no onset device, which is what makes them paragraph-final rather than row-final. The close is the recognition refrain at Ezek.38.23 from the census's strict list with a samekh after that verse. The four internal samekh, after Ezek.38.9, Ezek.38.13, Ezek.38.16 and Ezek.38.17, carry no formula and are disclosed without deciding; the one-verse tradition paragraph at Ezek.38.17 is disclosed and not cut, which also respects the bar on a row under three verses that is not a complete word-event unit. Its mark, paseq and note disclosures all check against the inventories, and medium_low with the cap disclosure and the frontier flag is the right posture for a whole-chapter span in a region where onset and close collide.

Second, the row's onset is its weak side: the messenger formula at Ezek.39.25 brings no change of addressee, since the house of Israel is the referent on both sides of the seam, and the verse behind it, Ezek.39.24, carries no text-formula close at all, only a samekh. The span is very probably right and its close is the strongest in this part, but high does not match evidence that is top-grade on one boundary and tier-3 plus a topical turn on the other, in a stretch whose unit-role question is openly held.
